subject: general
question:
Five persons, P, Q, R, S and T travelled in different months of the same year viz. January, February, March, April and May.

Q travelled in February. Only one person travelled between Q and P. Only three people travelled between T and R. R travelled in a month after P. Who among them travelled in May?
solution:
**Given: **Five persons, P, Q, R, S and T travelled in different months of the same year viz. January, February, March, April and May.

1) Q travelled in February.

2) Only one person travelled between Q and P.

3) Only three people travelled between T and R.

4) R travelled in a month after P. 

After positioning T and R only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. S.

Thus, according to the final arrangement R travelled in May.

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
